# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for F Prime CI
#
# Known design issue: Drv::SocketComponentHelper may close a socket descriptor
# from one thread (e.g. send() observing a disconnect, or an explicit close())
# while the read task is concurrently blocked in recv() on the same descriptor.
# The read path intentionally copies the descriptor and receives outside the
# lock so that a blocking recv() does not hold the mutex. Resolving this
# requires a descriptor-ownership redesign and is tracked as follow-up work.
race:Drv::IpSocket::close
